parameters.jsCode: const response=$input.first().json;const clean=s=>String(s??'').trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/```\s*$/,'').trim();const parseText=s=>{const t=clean(s);if(!t)return null;try{return JSON.parse(t);}catch{}const a=t.indexOf('{'),b=t.lastIndexOf('}');if(a>=0&&b>a){try{return JSON.parse(t.slice(a,b+1));}catch{}}const x=t.indexOf('['),y=t.lastIndexOf(']');if(x>=0&&y>x){try{return JSON.parse(t.slice(x,y+1));}catch{}}return null;};const looksLikeDraftArray=v=>Array.isArray(v)&&v.some(d=>d&&typeof d==='object'&&('platform'in d||'outputType'in d||'body'in d));const findDrafts=(v,depth=0)=>{if(depth>8||v==null)return null;if(looksLikeDraftArray(v))return v;if(typeof v==='string'){const p=parseText(v);return p?findDrafts(p,depth+1):null;}if(Array.isArray(v)){for(const item of v){const found=findDrafts(item,depth+1);if(found)return found;}return null;}if(typeof v==='object'){if(Array.isArray(v.drafts))return v.drafts;for(const key of ['output','text','content','response','message','data','result','json']){if(key in v){const found=findDrafts(v[key],depth+1);if(found)return found;}}for(const value of Object.values(v)){const found=findDrafts(value,depth+1);if(found)return found;}}return null;};const drafts=findDrafts(response);if(!Array.isArray(drafts)||!drafts.length)throw new Error('AI returned no usable distribution drafts. AI response preview: '+JSON.stringify(response).slice(0,900));const prep=$('Prepare Distribution Prompt').first().json;return [{json:{parentRecordId:prep.parentRecordId,drafts:drafts.map(d=>({...d,clipRecordId:String(d.clipRecordId??'').trim(),platform:String(d.platform??'').trim(),outputType:String(d.outputType??d.output_type??'').trim(),title:String(d.title??'').trim(),body:String(d.body??d.copy??d.caption??'').trim(),mediaUrl:String(d.mediaUrl??d.media_url??'').trim()}))}}];
